sources.title: GitHub - facebookresearch/moco-v3: PyTorch implementation of MoCo v3 ...
sources.snippet: This is a PyTorch implementation of MoCo v3 for self-supervised ResNet and ViT. The original MoCo v3 was implemented in Tensorflow and run in TPUs. This repo re-implements in PyTorch and GPUs. Despite the library and numerical differences, this repo reproduces the results and observations in the paper.
